group_representative: lowest image_id among existing analysis-unit representatives in the split group
train_support: within each seed, use only train group representatives, rank by SHA256 of salt|seed|split_group and take the first eight per leaf
calibration: one label-blind representative per eligible split group, all eligible groups, 16 fixed flat and Climbing policies; separate family budget per model, readout, split and population
test: all eligible analysis-unit representatives for primary test point estimates, plus one representative per group for comparison with the calibration unit
taxonomy_scope: HAM research grouping reviewed against the dataset descriptor, with the pilot topology and prompts retained. Clinical review remains pending.
